7. The official should have satisfactorily completed period of probation and rendered not less than five years of regular continuous service including the period of probation. - Rule 50 (5).
8. Maximum period is 36 months for CHS Officers and 24 months for others in the entire service and may be granted at a stretch or in different spells. - GIDs (1) and (2), Rule 51.
